Morgan found a new Hopper and has decided to take him under her wing to teach him the ropes!
What kind of mischief can two rampant Hoppers cause when loose on the town?…

This is one of my fan favourite comics, with some fan favourite girls! Enjoy Morgan and Josh's bouncy bunny night out!
